claude.result:
`subtrack add "Meal kit" 59.90 --every week` now works. The full suite passes (35 tests). I also ran that command by hand with `--since 2026-10-20`. It showed "€259.57 a month", and `renewals` listed it on 27 Oct, 7 days after its first charge.

- **Weekly plans:** they cost price × 52 ÷ 12 a month (€12 a week gives €52.00), and they charge every 7 days from `--since`. `--every weekly` is accepted too. The main change is in `src/cycles.js`, and the usage text and README mention the new cycle.
- **Rounding:** monthly costs now round to the nearest cent, so the €119.99 yearly plan shows €10.00. I changed the old "cut to the cent" test to match.
- **`export` fix:** `export` had its own copy of the monthly-cost calculation, which would have kept truncating and would not have handled weekly plans. It now uses the shared one.
- **Stored plans:** the old-file upgrade in `src/store.js` turned any cycle other than yearly into monthly. It would have silently turned saved weekly plans into monthly ones, so it now keeps them weekly.
- **Not requested, `renewals` ordering:** it sorted by the short label ("2 Nov") as text, so "10 Nov" sorted before "2 Nov". Weekly plans make same-month ordering matter more, so I changed it to sort by the real date.

I haven't committed anything.
